newsitem.title: FRANCE: OATs outperform Bunds, EU minister reach deal.
newsitem.headline: OATs outperform Bunds, EU minister reach deal.

text.p: 1310 GMT - OATs outperform Bunds on the spread, stealing five basis points from earlier in the session. EU finance ministers reach long-awaited agreement on EMU budget stability pact, budget pact and jobs agreement will be linked, as sought by French government. Further details yet to be released. BTPs, gilts gain slightly. Treasuries seize two basis points from earlier.
Government bond spreads are calculated from Reuter benchmark bond price data and adjusted to take into account interest payment frequency.
